look: Coilqueen Naga, a B-rank GKOM variant from the Glint Serpents family: naga priestess with a serpent lower body, ornate temple robes and a crystal crown. Family anatomy: serpents with jewelled scales and petrifying eyes; higher forms have humanoid naga torsos. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: half the body armoured in GKOM crystal, natural patches between the plates; the crystals are emerald glint crystal. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, strong stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
